correctness.rationale: The factor 1/2 in H_theta gives tr(H_theta^2)=S/2 and det(H_theta)=Re(e^(3i theta)abc)/4, by the two oriented three-cycles in the determinant. Thus the characteristic cubic is lambda^3−S lambda/4−Re(e^(3i theta)abc)/4. Reflecting all roots changes the sign of the product term but not the norm. For positive product the trace-zero real roots consist of one positive and two negative roots, and the positive one has largest modulus by the zero sum; at zero product the roots are 0 and ±sqrt(S)/2. The largest-root branch becomes sqrt(S/3) cos(arccos(eta |cos(3 theta+arg abc)|)/3). Averaging folds the absolute cosine to [0,pi/2] with density 2/pi; the phase and triple frequency do not affect that distribution. The integrand increases strictly in eta except at the measure-zero endpoint pi/2. The endpoint integrals are S/4 and S(1/6+sqrt(3)/(4 pi)). AM–GM gives their stated equality cases; continuity along a normalized path from (sqrt(S),0,0) to equal positive magnitudes realizes the entire interval. S=0 is separate and eta is not defined there. This analytical check covers all allowed phases and degeneracies. CHECK.py was inspected, not run.
